Provides React UI, charts, state, validation, and utility libraries for Firedancer.

# Purpose
This code is a bundled React user interface for slot and transaction analysis. It builds views that show slot progress, bank activity, TPU waterfall data, transaction timing, fees, tips, compute units, and reward breakdowns, and it uses chart plugins, tooltips, filters, and selection controls to inspect one slot or compare many slots. Many components read slot transaction records, group them by bank, filter them by state or source, and render charts and tables from the same data set. It also includes small UI parts for search, navigation, status icons, and summary cards, and it exposes reusable React components, helper functions, internal state stores, and chart plugins for use by other parts of the application.
